titulo: AI power users claim Anthropic duped them with subscriptions, and they’re taking it to court
cuerpo: Anthropic says power users are key to its business - it's prioritized them even when it means cutting off other popular applications, like OpenClaw. But some of these same customers say Anthropic misled them into believing they'd get more out of a top-tier pricing subscription than they did. In an expanded class action lawsuit filed […]
